reason: 该插件的主要面向价值是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Pi-compatible 的智能体预设入口，使用户可在会话中使用与 Pi 风格一致的核心文件/终端/检索工具并保留 DSH 扩展能力，因此可归类为自动化执行与代理工作流辅助类插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 Pi-compatible 智能体预设，支持小写核心工具契约的文件、搜索与终端调用，并可配合 DSH 提供的任务、计划、搜索与 Todo/Slash 等扩展。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Pi-compatible agent preset to DeepSeek Harness with core file, search, and terminal tools, and includes DSH-backed extensions such as task, planning, search, and todo/slash features.

capabilities: shell command execution via provided bash tool
invocation of DSH-backed agent extensions (web search, task/plan/todo/think/slash)
local preset installation/overwrite behavior in DSH agent preset directory

reasons.code: README states Pi-compatible preset provides core tools read, write, edit, bash, find, grep, and ls.
README identifies DSH-backed extensions WebSearch, Task, ExitPlanMode, Think, TodoWrite, and SlashCommand.
README describes installation flow that writes preset files into ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/pi-compatible/ and supports force upgrade behavior.
package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch and exports plugin entrypoints, indicating distributed plugin behavior.
repository tree includes pi-core-fs.mjs, pi-core-shell.mjs, pi-core-search.mjs and related preset files matching documented tool set.

capabilities: shell command execution via provided bash tool
invocation of DSH-backed agent extensions (web search, task/plan/todo/think/slash)
local preset installation/overwrite behavior in DSH agent preset directory
